title: Odile and the Verdict
author: Felix Ashgrove
blurb: Ines Quintana, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
